String chapter A's formulas into one closed production line: the compressor drinks §66,400 steam/s§r, puts out §61,600 superheated/s§r and tips §130 L/s§r of distilled water back; that water reboils into §64,800 steam/s§r.

On this loop a bronze air compressor rated §6400 L/s§r runs on superheated as §63,200 L air/s§r — §2a 4x throughput at zero net steam cost§r.

Line up the reservoir, the compressor and the steam eaters in a row, and the books close themselves.
